subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Can an authorized ClawHub operator take custody of an official GitHub OAuth App, rotate the production credentials, and approve the callback/redirect configuration before live validation?
rationale: The repository deliberately reads credentials from production environment variables, while OAuth-app ownership and secret rotation require external privileged access that source review cannot safely exercise.

options.title: Rotate to official OAuth custody
options.body: Create or transfer an organization-controlled OAuth App, update production credentials, and verify the resulting consent screen and both authentication flows.

options.title: Confirm a different approved identity path
options.body: If another official OAuth identity already exists, document its custody and migrate the deployed client to it with the same live validation.

options.title: Pause production migration
options.body: Keep the issue open with the trust risk visible until an authorized owner is available to perform the external configuration change.

recommendation.title: Rotate to official OAuth custody
recommendation.body: Create or transfer an organization-controlled OAuth App, update production credentials, and verify the resulting consent screen and both authentication flows.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned routing contact on the canonical report covering this same OAuth production boundary.
